title: Feedback on "Vertical Kampung" Project at Admiralty and Plans to Expand These to Other Estates
what_it_is: Feedback on "Vertical Kampung" Project at Admiralty and Plans to Expand These to Other Estates

sections.label: Kampung spirit among residents
sections.summary: The project aims to foster a kampung spirit where residents of all ages live, interact and look out for one another, with positive feedback and outcomes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As the name suggests, we hope to foster a “kampung” spirit where residents of all ages live, interact and look out for one another.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Feedback and outcomes from the project have been positive.

sections.label: Integrated developments and Community Care Apartments
sections.summary: HDB launched Heart of Yew Tee in 2021 and will launch a second Community Care Apartments pilot in Queenstown, integrating elderly housing with community facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Following the success of Kampung Admiralty, HDB launched the next integrated development, Heart of Yew Tee, at Yew Tee Close in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This development will integrate housing for the elderly with community facilities, such as a hawker centre, polyclinic, community club and a kidney dialysis centre.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: HDB will continue to explore opportunities to develop more of such “vertical kampungs”, to foster stronger community bonds amongst Singaporeans, taking into consideration the availability of suitable sites and the needs of residents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For the upcoming November BTO exercise, we will be launching our second Community Care Apartments (CCAs) pilot situated within the Health District at Queenstown.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: CCAs will be built together with the BTO flats in the same precinct, promoting intergenerational bonding as seniors living at CCAs and young families living nearby will all be part of the same community.

sections.label: Enhancement for Active Seniors programme
sections.summary: The EASE programme installs grab bars, non-slip toilet flooring, ramps, wheelchair lifters and ramps for those living in situ.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For those who live in situ, we have the Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE) programme where we put in grab bars, non-slip flooring in the toilet, ramps and, even in the front of the flat, wheelchair lifters and ramps for wheelchairs, if necessary.
